author: Zintenka
body:
Part 1: About You

What is your age? 18

What is your Discord ID? (If you don’t have Discord, create an account and join the Avicus Discord server before answering this question.) 6352

How active can you be in order to contribute to the team? I can be pretty active now that I've come back.

What attributes distinguish yourself from other applicants that qualify you to be a builder? Well, I'm experienced and mature. I have great teamwork abilities and I've worked well with teams in the past.

Part 2: Skills

What do you think is a necessity in order to hone your map building skills in terms of gameplay? Try to think on whether an item will disrupt the gameplay of the map by being too OP or too underpowered.

And whether terrain is adequate, I'm guilty of this in the past and I will do my best to make sure that terrain is dynamic but accessible instead of being cumbersome for players.

How comfortable are you with Avicus XML when it comes to creating it and analyzing it to fix possible errors? I pretty comfortable, though I've only just come back from a hiatus.

As builder, would you focus on building maps, creating XML, or both? Both.

Part 3: Past Experience

Provide the links for the threads of two maps that you have submitted to the Avicus forums. There are two pages worth of maps that I've made.

https://avicus.net/forums/search?utf8=%E2%9C%93&category_id=43&tag=&author=Zintenka&query=&commit=Se...

Have you had any past experience with building maps or creating XML, other than with the two maps linked above? If so, explain.

Much experience, I've made mixed gamemodes, I've made TNT maps, I've made other types of maps and I've helped other people with making maps as well.

Part 4: Self Reflection

Why do you want to be a builder? I want to gift the server with new and exciting maps that will keep players' attention.

How do you think you will help the map development team? By bringing forth new ideas for one and using XML modules for creative things. 
And suggest new ideas like a server that allows you to test XML with the map creator.

title: Zintenka's Builder App

replies.author: Fouled
replies.body:
Hello,

We have decided to deny your application for the following reason(s):

- We want to see you become more active with map related content (give feedback for maps on the forums, build maps, etc), especially since you just came back to the server not so long ago. Once improved on this, you should apply for when the applications next open.

Good luck and thanks for applying!
